text:
*The north gate has been modified — you can see it now, in the grey predawn light. New hinges, the old lock replaced, the bar mechanism altered to open from outside. Harren's renovation project was a trap built in plain sight.*

*You work fast with whatever hands are available, re-barricading the gate with anything heavy — carts, barrels, stone blocks. It won't hold a determined army forever, but it will buy time.*

*A scout runs up, breathless.*

Scout: "Dust cloud on the north road. At least five hundred men. Varketh's banners. They'll be here by noon."

*Time is running out. The gate is secured for now, but Harren must be stopped or the city falls regardless.*

choices.text: Leave defenders at the gate and lead the assault on Harren
Stay and command the gate defense personally
